SELECT
    pid,
    usename,
    client_addr::text AS ip_origen,
    backend_start,
    state,
    TRUE AS fuera_horario
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database()
  AND backend_type = 'client backend'
  AND usename <> 'agente_ia'
  AND (
    (backend_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::time >= TIME '23:00'
    OR
    (backend_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::time < TIME '06:00'
  );
